The `drift` tool as the server lists it in `tools/list`. Generated from turf-mcp-server v1.4.0-35-g019e962689 by `scripts/generate-reference.mjs`: change the server, then run `npm run generate`.

Change how the engine watches a workspace for drift between convergences: settle, sweep, confirm. Name at least one; the rest stand. The first call turns drift on for the workspace. Turning it on, the sweep above all, is the user's choice: the sweep reads every managed object unattended against the provider's API with the engine's credentials. Call it when the user asks or agrees, never on your own. Detection needs a feed or the sweep for signals, and a standing seal (taken from a converged round) for confirm. Returns the settings as they now stand and next: the watch.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** full

## Annotations

| Annotation | Value |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyHint` | false |
| `destructiveHint` | false |
| `idempotentHint` | true |
| `openWorldHint` | false |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Workspace alias, as 'open' named it. Omit for the workspace opened without an alias ('default'). |
| `settle` | integer | no | Seconds a changed object must be quiet before its signal is confirmed and becomes a notice; 0 takes the engine's default (30). |
| `sweep` | integer | no | Seconds one sweep cycle takes to read every managed object, unattended, against the provider's API with the engine's credentials; 0 turns the sweep off. |
| `confirm` | boolean | no | false: no confirming read, so every notice stays unconfirmed; true: confirm reads a settled object against the standing seal (the default). |
